prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: [验证] 连续高行 · 发布计划 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 4 columns × 7 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "阶段" · longest unbreakable word 32px · one-line width 67px
  col 2: header "时间" · longest unbreakable word 26px · one-line width 44px
  col 3: header "负责人" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 46px
  col 4: header "内容" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 736px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 720px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 719px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"展示发布计划各阶段的时间、负责人和执行内容，便于跟踪从冻结到复盘的进度。","reading":"读者先按时间和阶段纵向扫描，再横向核对负责人及具体安排；灰度阶段的长内容会形成较高的行，可在这些行内容纳必要的换行。","groups":["阶段和时间共同标识发布进程，适合相邻扫描。","负责人和内容共同说明每个阶段由谁执行、要做什么；内容列承担主要的叙述空间。"],"keep_intact":["日期如 05-06 应保持完整。","负责人姓名应保持完整。","灰度比例中的数字与百分号应保持完整。"],"may_wrap":["灰度阶段名称可在文字与比例之间换行。","内容列中的长句可按自然语义换行；较短的内容宜保持单行。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r0A: widths [88, 65, 67, 499] · table 720×325px · row heights [36, 36, 60, 60, 60, 36, 36] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0B: widths [105, 75, 75, 464] · table 720×325px · row heights [36, 36, 60, 60, 60, 36, 36] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0C: widths [75, 65, 67, 512] · table 720×325px · row heights [36, 36, 60, 60, 60, 36, 36] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r0A","good":"阶段、日期和负责人均保持单行，三段灰度内容各占两行，行内对应关系清楚；内容列宽裕，整体紧凑。","problems":"部分长句在词语中间换行，例如“指标”被拆开，第二行的开头略显突兀。","cause":"内容列为499px，长句恰好在词语中间到达换行点；阶段列88px已接近完整容纳最长阶段名称所需的宽度，进一步压缩会使其换行。"},{"design":"r0B","good":"阶段、时间和负责人列都有较宽松的留白，所有标识完整，内容仍控制在两行内。","problems":"前三列的空白偏多，挤占叙述空间；灰度内容的换行更早，例如“核心指标”被拆开，第二行也更长，削弱了扫描节奏。","cause":"前三列合计255px，比r0A多35px，内容列因此缩至464px。"},{"design":"r0C","good":"内容列最宽，长句获得更多空间；日期和姓名仍完整，灰度行高度没有增加。","problems":"三个灰度阶段名称都被拆成两行，百分比落在下一行，阶段标识不如单行时容易纵向比较；新增内容宽度也没有消除内容列中所有不自然的断行。","cause":"阶段列仅75px，扣除边距后不足以容纳最长阶段名称；节省的宽度分配给了512px的内容列。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"balanced","widths":[88,65,67,499],"change":"保留r0A的均衡方案作为对照：阶段名称完整，时间和负责人紧凑，剩余空间用于内容。"},{"name":"content-plus","widths":[88,65,65,501],"change":"在保持阶段和日期完整的前提下，将负责人列收窄2px，给内容列多留一点空间，观察长句断行是否改善。"},{"name":"stage-wrap","widths":[80,65,67,507],"change":"尝试介于r0A与r0C之间的阶段列宽度，将8px转给内容列，观察能否改善长句换行，同时限制阶段名称换行的影响。"}]}
